verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke has a dedicated 'Brands, trade marks and designs' service page under its IP practice. It explicitly lists trade mark clearance and filing programmes, plus brand management, exploitation and enforcement, including anti-counterfeiting strategies. This covers clearance, registration and enforcement as a distinct practice. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration (e.g. directory rankings or client reviews), and trademark-specific case studies or named team details comparable to those shown for the patents practice.
